label: 西方奇幻 Q 版软 3D

proportions.silhouette: moderate compact chibi; large rounded head, short sturdy limbs, small torso and readable hands/feet

shape_language: soft bevels and thick readable accessory shapes
oversized expressive eyes with compact facial spacing
avoid thin fragile straps and realistic micro-detail

render_language.surface: clean matte colors with restrained roughness variation
render_language.lighting: soft studio key and fill with subtle ambient occlusion
render_language.linework: no heavy outline; shape separation comes from value and occlusion
render_language.detail_density: low to medium; every detail must remain readable at game camera distance

positive: moderate compact chibi proportions around 2.1 to 2.5 heads tall
smooth rounded low-frequency geometry and thick readable silhouettes
clean matte material colors, soft studio light, subtle ambient occlusion
negative: realistic adult proportions or long slender limbs
photoreal skin, painterly brushwork, noisy micro-texture
thin fragile straps, excessive ornaments, sharp high-frequency detail
perspective distortion, action pose, dramatic lighting

checks: same material response across character and accessory
